name: Chinese assistant flow iteration5: 30 exposed regressions plus 6 new validation scenes
purpose: Same blind rubric and thresholds; expanded regression denominator; no scored case removed. Fixed user turns are not real-human satisfaction.

userTurns: 我明早要和同事说明项目晚两天交付，不是他的原因。帮我想一句自然的说法。
再随意一点，我们平时说话没那么正式。

好，就用这一版。
cases.expectations: 直接给可用话术，后续改写保留晚两天与中性原因，响应随意风格；接受后自然收口，不重讲沟通原则。
cases.exposure: Exposed earlier cycle; retained only as development regression
